title: Isolate memory extraction and compaction lifecycle from the conversation service
requirements: ConversationMaintenance owns extraction tasks, scope reservations, extraction concurrency, compaction tasks, per-scope compaction budget and shutdown without importing service or concrete adapters.

Extraction is scheduled after actual message persistence only for positive counts at the configured interval, at most one task per scope and two concurrent extractions by default; failures log without automatic retry.

Compaction is scheduled only at the successful reply-delivery boundary, excludes operator events and disabled compaction, preserves group and private scope and current event ID, and retains the existing independent per-scope budget.

Closing maintenance rejects new work, cancels and awaits running or queued jobs and supports repeated, concurrent and cancelled closers; service must finish this cleanup even when observation shutdown fails or is cancelled.

Service delegates to one maintenance owner without duplicate state or obsolete forwarding methods; all historical acceptance, regression, architecture, lint, wheel and coverage checks remain required.
